shared_elements: repeated small radial or petal-like elements
justification: Both are tall vertical stone surfaces bearing shallow relief that includes rounded, radiating disc-like motifs (a single large ringed disc on A; repeated rosettes/palmette heads on B), and both use curving linear elements to connect or frame those rounded forms. Beyond that the works diverge sharply: A is a three-dimensional, weathered anthropomorphic block whose motifs are sparse, schematic and organised around a body axis with horizontal banding, whereas B is a flat, evenly worked slab covered by a regular all-over vegetal scroll of naturalistic flowers, crisply and uniformly cut.
